finding.behavior: The method synchronously takes the live connection and floats it into the pool while constructing the returned future. Polling the future performs the release ping and final return/close maintenance.
finding.impact: An unpolled return_to_pool future does not keep pool.size() at the checked-out count. Pool::close may observe the floating connection, close it, and reach size 0 before the future is polled.
finding.classification: 验收前置条件与当前 SQLx API 语义不相容；保留失败，不修改生产关闭逻辑、不放宽门、不将其记为通过。
